hypothesis: Acquire Dst once per output tile; keep R/G/B/T in Dst[0..3] across the Gaussian loop. Storage relocation only, should be bit-identical.
Expand Q = A·x² + B·xy + C·y² + D·x + E·y + F with tile-local centered coords. RECLASSIFIED 2026-05-25 as building block under 40 dB perceptual PSNR floor (see 2026-05-25-fpu-heavy-architecture.md).

M1 of FPU-heavy roadmap. Rewrite per-Gaussian Q in basis form with HOST-side coefficients (A,B,C,D,E,F). Kernel builds Q in one DST slot via 6 mul_tiles FMA against precomputed basis tiles (x², xy, y², x, y, 1). Replaces the SFPU dx/dy/sq/mul chain with pure FPU FMA accumulation. PSNR floor 40 dB (perceptual). Timing may regress slightly vs iter-0 baseline; OK — M3 reclaims it. See docs/superpowers/specs/2026-05-25-fpu-heavy-architecture.md §M1.

M2 of FPU-heavy roadmap. The 6 basis tiles are owner-tile-local and identical across owner tiles. Compute them in a one-shot compute kernel that runs at the start of each frame and writes them to a fixed DRAM region. Reader streams them to all cores. See spec §M2.

M3 of FPU-heavy roadmap. Eliminate CB_COLOR_R/G/B_STATE, CB_T_STATE, CB_SAT_MASK as L1 spill targets. One tile_regs_acquire() per output tile. Init dst[0..3] = (0,0,0,1). Per Gaussian: build Q (M1), exp, alpha-clamp, contrib, SFPU DST×DST color/T updates. Use binary_dest_reuse_tiles<ELWMUL,DEST_TO_SRCA> for α *= opacity. See spec §M3.

M4 of FPU-heavy roadmap. Decompose 32×32 owner tile into 4×16×16 faces with independent Gaussian streams (4 CBs cb_f0..cb_f3). process_face<cb_fN>(countN) within the single acquire. log_mask_face added before exp_tile to zero contributions from other faces. Expected ~3-4× fewer Gaussians visited per face. See spec §M4.
Use per-Gaussian (μ, Σ) for 3σ ellipse bbox vs conservative axis-aligned.
Skip kernel launch for tiles with zero assigned Gaussians.
